uutiset.t: Thitikul wins third title in a row at LPGA finale
uutiset.s: World number two Jeeno Thitikul produces a seven-under final round of 65 to claim a third successive CME Group Tour Championship title.

uutiset.t: Fifa to confirm UK bid to host 2035 Women's World Cup
uutiset.s: Fifa is set to confirm on Monday that a first football World Cup will be hosted in the United Kingdom since 1966.

uutiset.t: 'World's best could've lost 4-0' - but should Man Utd have done more at Anfield?
uutiset.s: Mauricio Pochettino believes even the best team in the world could have conceded four goals at Liverpool in Manchester United's circumstances - but should the Red Devils have done more in defeat?

uutiset.t: Chaotic week, nightmare start and huge reality check for Pochettino
uutiset.s: Mauricio Pochettino's reign as Manchester United boss could barely have got off to a more chastening start, writes Simon Stone.

uutiset.t: Price wins Grand Slam to end wait for major title
uutiset.s: Gerwyn Price ends his four-year wait for a major PDC title as he powers to a brilliant 16-11 victory over Gian van Veen in the Grand Slam of Darts final.

uutiset.t: Pepe did not injure eyes staring at sun, say Villarreal
uutiset.s: Villarreal say reports striker Nicolas Pepe needed eye surgery because he stared directly at the solar eclipse are "completely false".

uutiset.t: Man Utd plotting Toney move - Monday's gossip
uutiset.s: Manchester United eye move for Al-Ahli striker Ivan Toney, Fulham hold contract talks with Calvin Bassey and PSG could step up pursuit of Eli Junior Kroupi.

uutiset.t: Alcaraz outplays Zverev for first ATP Finals triumph
uutiset.s: Carlos Alcaraz ends his wait for a first ATP Finals title as he outplays world number one Alexander Zverev in Turin.

uutiset.t: McBurnie stoppage-time double earns Hull win over 10-man Brighton
uutiset.s: Oli McBurnie's stoppage-time double earns victory for Hull City against second-placed Brighton in the Premier League.

uutiset.t: Ngumoha stars as Liverpool thrash 10-man Man Utd
uutiset.s: Mauricio Pochettino's reign as Manchester United head coach begins in desperate fashion as his team are thrashed by rivals Liverpool to remain in the Premier League relegation zone.

uutiset.t: Camara to continue with Haas for final two races
uutiset.s: Brazilian Rafael Camara will continue to race for the Haas team for the final two grands prix of the Formula 1 season.

uutiset.t: Iraola 'enjoyed' big win over Man Utd
uutiset.s: Liverpool head coach Andoni Iraola is pleased with his side's performance in their dominant win over Manchester United although he says that his side can still play better.

uutiset.t: From conceding seven to Hull heroics - how Tzolakis recovered to defy Brighton
uutiset.s: Nine days after playing for Greece in a nightmare 7-0 loss, keeper Konstantinos Tzolakis plays a pivotal role in Hull's Premier League win against Brighton.

uutiset.t: Pochettino on 'painful' defeat in first game as Man Utd boss
uutiset.s: Manchester United's new head coach Mauricio Pochettino says his side must transform "anger" from their thumping at the hands of Liverpool into "energy" to improve under his reign.

uutiset.s: How Liverpool and Manchester United's players rated following their Premier League match.
